title: Stop using Wombat for publishing npms

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides clear, actionable instructions to stop using Wombat Dressing Room for publishing npm packages and transition to OSS Exit Gates for NPM in compliance with MOSS requirements.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Migrating the NPM publishing process from Wombat Dressing Room to OSS Exit Gates requires a major overhaul of CI/CD release infrastructure across multiple GitHub workflows, custom composite actions, .npmrc configurations, and release documentation.

summary.problem: The repository currently uses Wombat Dressing Room for publishing npm packages, which must be replaced with OSS Exit Gates for NPM to comply with MOSS Capability 1, Step 12 requirements.
summary.root_cause: Existing release workflows, composite actions, .npmrc, and documentation rely on Wombat Dressing Room registry endpoints (https://wombat-dressing-room.appspot.com) and Wombat token secrets (WOMBAT_TOKEN_*).
summary.context: MOSS Capability 1, Step 12 mandates that all open source npm packages be published via trusted methods such as OSS Exit Gates for NPM.

steps: Update .npmrc and .github/actions/setup-npmrc/action.yml to remove Wombat registry URLs and replace them with the official NPM registry / OSS Exit Gate endpoint configuration.

Modify .github/actions/npm-auth-token/action.yml to replace Wombat token parameters (wombat-token-cli, wombat-token-core, wombat-token-a2a-server) with authentication mechanics required by OSS Exit Gates.
Update composite actions .github/actions/publish-release/action.yml and .github/actions/tag-npm-release/action.yml to use the updated auth token action and updated parameters.

Update release workflow files (.github/workflows/release-manual.yml, release-nightly.yml, release-promote.yml, release-patch-3-release.yml, release-change-tags.yml, release-rollback.yml) to remove WOMBAT_TOKEN_* secret references and configure OSS Exit Gate authentication.
Update documentation in docs/releases.md to reflect the new NPM release process using OSS Exit Gates instead of Wombat Dressing Room.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: NPM package releases and tag updates authenticate through OSS Exit Gates for NPM without referencing Wombat Dressing Room endpoints or secrets.
verification_steps: Trigger manual dry-run release workflow (release-manual.yml) to verify workflow execution and npm configuration without publishing.
Verify that .npmrc no longer contains references to wombat-dressing-room.appspot.com.
Verify that all GitHub action steps compile and pass workflow validation.
